title: Four generations of horses
description: Nova's family in Minecraft 26.3. Vanilla AI bred every horse after the founders.

title: Pan and zoom across the family
description: The same four generations in the tree screen.

title: One family, two players
description: Alex has the mod and sees the tree. Kai joined without it and uses /familytree.

title: Chest menus for players without the mod
description: Click an animal to see its parents and grandparents. Real clicks on an unmodded 1.21.1 client.

title: The family as a book
description: Players without the mod can turn a family into a written book.

title: Other players' animals are view-only
description: Only the owner or an operator can rename, locate, or add parents.

title: Did the baby beat its parents?
description: A green ▲ beat both parents. A red ▼ fell below both.

title: Breeding, recorded
description: Feed two horses golden carrots and their baby joins the tree.

title: Family details in Jade
description: Name, parents, generation, and each stat beside the parents' values.

title: Wool colors mix
description: A white and a red sheep had a pink lamb.

title: A brown panda from two carriers
description: Both parents carried the hidden brown gene.

title: Tabs and search
description: Search by name, species, or color. The blue axolotl was spawned for the scene, not bred.

title: JourneyMap waypoint from the tree
description: Waypoint in a tree marks where the pet stands.

title: Export the family as a PNG
description: Each horse's speed, jump, and health. No player names or coordinates.

title: Add parents you already know
description: Pick two parents for a pet you had before installing. Staged example family.

title: Plan a baby before you breed
description: Stat ranges, the chance to beat both parents, color odds, and how related the pair is.

title: Compare, plan, and find the best pairs
description: Best pairs ranks every pair in a herd of 24 horses.

title: What each player sees
description: With default settings, a parent owned by another player shows as unknown.

title: Commented server settings
description: Each setting lists its default and allowed values.

title: /familytree reload reports bad values
description: Family Tree names each problem and the value it uses instead.

title: Permission nodes in LuckPerms
description: Grant or deny each action with familytree.* nodes.

title: See relatives in the world
description: Parents glow orange, siblings green, and children blue, each with a label.

title: Relatives light up
description: Hold the key and look at an animal. Children show in blue, grandchildren in purple.

title: Family Tree on a Paper server
description: The same chest menus from the plugin on Paper, Purpur, and Spigot.

title: Rename in an anvil, without the mod
description: The plugin's Rename button opens an anvil. The animal's name in the world stays the same.

title: Plan breeding from the chest menu
description: Pick a mate and read the baby's odds as a book.

title: Mod screens on a plugin server
description: Players with the client mod get the full screens on Paper.
